job_title: Hotel Manager - Quản Lý Khách Sạn
languages_required: Tiếng Anh Giao tiếp cơ bản
Tiếng Trung Giao tiếp cơ bản
benefits: Competitive salary package and attractive employee benefits.
Work with a young, dynamic team under a modern management model.
Opportunity to work in a multinational company with exposure to a diverse cultural and multilingual environment.
Public holidays and leave entitlements in accordance with Vietnamese Labor Law.
description:
A. Hotel Operations
Oversee daily hotel operations and develop business plans to achieve revenue, occupancy (OCC), RevPAR and profit targets.
B. Financial & Revenue Management
Manage budgets, monitor P&L, control operating costs, analyze market trends and optimize room rates and revenue strategies.
C. Team Management
Lead recruitment, onboarding, training and performance evaluation.
Develop a flexible, multi-skilled team and improve employee retention.
D. Service Quality
Ensure compliance with brand standards and SOPs, maintain room quality and service consistency, handle guest complaints, and improve OTA ratings and guest satisfaction.
E. Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with local regulations on fire safety, security, hygiene and other operational requirements.
F. External Relations & Coordination
Maintain effective relationships with local authorities, property management and business partners, while coordinating closely with the owner and brand operations team.
requirements_text:
Requirements
Associate's degree or above.
At least 3 years of hotel industry experience, including 1 year in a hotel management or equivalent supervisory role.
Experience in economy or mid-scale chain hotels, especially pre-opening or hotel operations, is preferred.
Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and financial management skills.
Proficiency in Vietnamese and Chinese or English is highly preferred.
Ability to work under pressure and maintain high standards of professionalism and integrity.
